post.title: Top K Elements Pattern: Find the Best K Without Sorting Everything
post.subtitle: Maintain a min-heap of size K. Anything smaller than the current minimum gets evicted immediately.
post.brief: To find the top K largest elements, maintain a **min-heap of size K**. For every new element, push it onto the heap. If the heap exceeds K, evict the minimum. After processing all N elements, the heap holds exactly the K largest. O(N log K) time — orders of magnitude faster than sorting when K is small.
